reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}
